about: The tractus of the formulary “Septuagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Out of the depths I have cried to You, O Lord; Lord, hear my voice. Let Your ears be attentive to the prayer of Your servant. If You mark iniquities, O Lord, Lord, who will stand? For there is forgiveness with You, and because of Your law I have waited for You, O Lord.

ex.w021: The future sustinébit supports a future-perfect reading of observáveris. The same form can also be perfect subjunctive, so the mood remains uncertain here.
